title: Separating Constraint Compliance from Semantic Accuracy: A Novel Benchmark for Evaluating Instruction-Following Under Compression
reasoning: The paper focuses on a technical benchmark for instruction-following and prompt compression. Although it includes the 'Harm Principle' (an ethical concept) as one of eight concepts used to test semantic accuracy, the study's objective is to measure structural constraint compliance and knowledge preservation in LLMs, not to evaluate or benchmark ethics, morals, or religion themselves.
